files.inner.sh:
# runs as mapped root inside the user+mount namespace; $1 is the scenario
H=/tmp/parity-home; FIX=$H/claude-fixture; OV=$H/ov; MARKS=$H/load-marks
set -e
/usr/bin/rm -rf "$OV" "$MARKS"
/usr/bin/mkdir -p "$OV/u-lib" "$OV/w-lib" "$OV/u-var" "$OV/w-var" "$OV/w-etc"
/usr/bin/cp -a "$FIX/etc-upper" "$OV/u-etc"
/usr/bin/mount -t overlay overlay -o "lowerdir=/usr/lib,upperdir=$OV/u-lib,workdir=$OV/w-lib" /usr/lib
/usr/bin/mount -t overlay overlay -o "lowerdir=/var/lib,upperdir=$OV/u-var,workdir=$OV/w-var" /var/lib
/usr/bin/mount -t overlay overlay -o "lowerdir=/etc,upperdir=$OV/u-etc,workdir=$OV/w-etc" /etc
/usr/bin/mount -t tmpfs tmpfs /root
/usr/bin/mkdir /root/loadables
ctl=$(/usr/bin/bash -c 'enable -f "$1" claude && claude version' _ "$FIX/claude.so" 2>&1)
/usr/bin/rm -f "$MARKS"
standin=NO; [[ $ctl == 'claude-fixture 2' ]] && standin=yes
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$CANDIDATE" /usr/bin/bash
set +e
static_build=no
if /usr/bin/ldd "$CANDIDATE" 2>&1 | /usr/bin/grep -q 'not a dynamic executable'; then static_build=yes; fi
export BASHPKG_LOADABLES_DATADIR=/root/loadables
stage() {
  /usr/bin/rm -rf /root/loadables; /usr/bin/mkdir /root/loadables
  /usr/bin/cp "$FIX/bashclaude_$1.pkg" "/root/loadables/bashclaude_$1.pkg"
  if [[ -f $FIX/bashclaude_$1.pkg.sig ]]; then /usr/bin/cp "$FIX/bashclaude_$1.pkg.sig" "/root/loadables/bashclaude_$1.pkg.sig"; fi
  PKG=/root/loadables/bashclaude_$1.pkg
}
nfiles() { nf=$(/usr/bin/find "$OV/u-lib" "$OV/u-var" -type f | /usr/bin/wc -l); }
nloads() { nl=0; if [[ -f $MARKS ]]; then nl=$(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$MARKS"); fi; }
installed() {
  inst=no
  if [[ -f /var/lib/pkg/installed/claude/sha256 && -f /usr/lib/bash-os/loadables/claude.so ]] \
     && /usr/bin/cmp -s /usr/lib/bash-os/loadables/claude.so "$FIX/claude.so" \
     && [[ $(< /var/lib/pkg/installed/claude/sha256) == "$(< "$FIX/valid.so.sha256")" ]]; then inst=yes; fi
}
# A pkg diagnostic ("NAME: line N: pkg: ...") shows the pkg verb itself refused
# the package, whether claude runs pkg in this shell or in a child bash.
reached() { reach=yes; if ! /usr/bin/grep -q '^claude update: installing ' "$H/err-$1" || ! /usr/bin/grep -Eq '^[^:]+: line [0-9]+: pkg: ' "$H/err-$1"; then reach=NO; fi; }

for name in tampered unsigned foreign bad-abi bad-arch bad-sha; do
  stage "$name"
  claude update 2> "$H/err-$name"; rc=$?
  nfiles; nloads; reached "$name"
  printf '%s: rc=%s files=%s loads=%s reached-pkg=%s\n' "$name" "$rc" "$nf" "$nl" "$reach"
done
stage valid
claude update > "$H/out-valid" 2> "$H/err-valid"; vrc=$?
installed
nloads
if [[ $static_build == yes ]]; then
  if [[ $inst != yes || $nl != 0 || $vrc == 0 ]] || ! /usr/bin/grep -q 'cannot load shared objects' "$H/err-valid"; then
    printf 'control-valid: installed=%s static-refused=no rc=%s loads=%s\n' "$inst" "$vrc" "$nl"
    exit 1
  fi
else
  if [[ $inst != yes || $vrc != 0 ]]; then
    printf 'control-valid: installed=%s rc=%s\n' "$inst" "$vrc"
    exit 1
  fi
fi
printf 'control-valid: installed=%s\n' "$inst"

cases.stdout:
tampered: rc=1 files=0 loads=0 reached-pkg=yes
unsigned: rc=1 files=0 loads=0 reached-pkg=yes
foreign: rc=1 files=0 loads=0 reached-pkg=yes
bad-abi: rc=1 files=0 loads=0 reached-pkg=yes
bad-arch: rc=1 files=0 loads=0 reached-pkg=yes
bad-sha: rc=1 files=0 loads=0 reached-pkg=yes
control-valid: installed=yes
cases.oracle: Independent fixture (mig-w3-claude-pkgs.py): gcc-built claude stand-in .so whose constructor records when it is loaded, packages signed with a fresh OpenSSL Ed25519 key (OpenSSL verifies every signature, and a flipped byte breaks the valid one), the matching public key installed in the default /etc/bashsignify/trusted of a private overlay. The invoking shell runs in a user+mount namespace where the candidate is bind-mounted over /usr/bin/bash, so pkg is the candidate's whether 'claude update' runs it in the invoking shell (0.1.4) or in a child '/bin/bash -lc' (earlier builds), with writable overlays over /usr/lib, /var/lib and /etc and a tmpfs over /root; the package under test is the only bashclaude_*.pkg in BASHPKG_LOADABLES_DATADIR (also the default /root/loadables) and 'claude update' is run without an argument, so selection does not depend on the environment hand-off of an explicit PKGFILE (that is case mig-w3-claude-update-selection). Six packages that must not install: a byte flipped after signing, no signature file, a signature by a key that is not trusted, manifest ABI bash-4.4, manifest architecture not of this machine, manifest digest that is not the .so digest. 'files' is the count of regular files that appeared in the writable /usr/lib and /var/lib overlays (find, not the candidate): none may appear. A control run of the valid package in the same namespace proves the same update path does install a verified package.
cases.comparison: r2: 'claude update' (the package staged as the only bashclaude_*.pkg of the data directory) rejects a tampered, unsigned, untrusted-signer, wrong-ABI, wrong-architecture and wrong-digest package before anything is installed (status 1, no state or loadable written, the stand-in never loaded), reaching the real pkg verbs each time. The same path installs the valid signed package. A dynamic build's control update also loads it (status 0). A static build installs it and pkg load refuses, before opening the object, with 'this executable is static and cannot load shared objects'; the stand-in is not loaded. The line control-valid: installed=yes is printed only when that build's outcome holds.

nloads() { nl=0; if [[ -f $MARKS ]]; then nl=$(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$MARKS"); fi; }

     && [[ $(< /var/lib/pkg/installed/claude/sha256) == "$(< "$FIX/valid.so.sha256")" ]]; then inst=yes; fi
}
reached() { reach=yes; if ! /usr/bin/grep -q '^claude update: installing ' "$H/err-$1" || ! /usr/bin/grep -q '^bash: line 1: pkg: ' "$H/err-$1"; then reach=NO; fi; }

case $1 in
ok)
  stage valid
  claude update > "$H/out-ok" 2> "$H/err-ok"; rc=$?
  installed; nloads
  line=; if [[ -f $MARKS ]]; then line=$(< "$MARKS"); fi
  order=no; [[ $line == *' state=1 so=1' ]] && order=yes
  printf 'standin-answers-in-reference-shell=%s\n' "$standin"

    if [[ $rc != 0 && $inst == yes && $nl == 0 ]] && /usr/bin/grep -q 'cannot load shared objects' "$H/err-ok"; then

    else
      printf 'ok: rc=%s installed=%s loads=%s static-refused=no\n' "$rc" "$inst" "$nl"
    fi
  else
    if [[ $rc == 0 && $inst == yes && $nl == 1 && $order == yes ]]; then
      printf 'ok: contract=honoured\n'
    else
      printf 'ok: rc=%s installed=%s loads=%s load-after-install=%s\n' "$rc" "$inst" "$nl" "$order"
    fi
  fi
  ;;

  stage noload
  claude update > "$H/out-loadfail" 2> "$H/err-loadfail"; rc=$?
  [[ -f /var/lib/pkg/installed/claude/sha256 && -f /usr/lib/bash-os/loadables/claude.so ]] && st=yes || st=no
  nloads
  line=; if [[ -f $MARKS ]]; then line=$(< "$MARKS"); fi
  printf '%s\n' "$line" > "$H/loadfail-mark"
  printf 'loadfail: rc=%s installed=%s\n' "$rc" "$st"
  ;;
noinstall)

  builtin pkg install "$PKG" > "$H/preinstall.out" 2> "$H/preinstall.err"; pre=$?

  /usr/bin/rm -f "$MARKS"
  stage tampered
  claude update > "$H/out-noinstall" 2> "$H/err-noinstall"; rc=$?
  nloads
  [[ $(< /var/lib/pkg/installed/claude/MANIFEST) == *'version: 1'* ]] && kept=yes || kept=no
  printf 'noinstall: preinstall=%s version=%s rc=%s loads=%s version-kept=%s\n' "$pre" "$v" "$rc" "$nl" "$kept"
  ;;
esac
files.run.sh:
for s in ok loadfail noinstall; do
  /usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount /usr/bin/env CANDIDATE="$BASH" "$BASH" --noprofile --norc "$PWD/inner.sh" "$s"
done

cases.stdout:
standin-answers-in-reference-shell=yes
ok: contract=honoured
loadfail: rc=1 installed=yes
noinstall: preinstall=0 version=1 rc=1 loads=0 version-kept=yes
cases.oracle: Independent fixture (mig-w3-claude-pkgs.py): gcc-built claude stand-in .so whose constructor records when it is loaded, packages signed with a fresh OpenSSL Ed25519 key (OpenSSL verifies every signature, and a flipped byte breaks the valid one), the matching public key installed in the default /etc/bashsignify/trusted of a private overlay. The invoking shell runs in a user+mount namespace where the candidate is bind-mounted over /usr/bin/bash, so the child '/bin/bash -lc' that 'claude update' starts is the candidate, with writable overlays over /usr/lib, /var/lib and /etc and a tmpfs over /root; the package under test is the only bashclaude_*.pkg in BASHPKG_LOADABLES_DATADIR (also the default /root/loadables) and 'claude update' is run without an argument, so selection does not depend on the environment hand-off of an explicit PKGFILE (that is case mig-w3-claude-update-selection). Three fresh namespaces. ok: the stand-in's own answer is first proven by loading it with 'enable -f' in the reference GNU bash (no claude builtin there); the valid package is then updated; installed state and loadable are checked byte-for-byte against the independently built .so and its SHA-256, and the stand-in's constructor records that the installed state and .so already existed when it was loaded (one load only). loadfail: a signed package whose .so lacks the claude_struct symbol installs but cannot load, so update must fail with status 1 after the install (the stand-in's constructor mark, if the loader got that far, is kept as a diagnostic). noinstall: a version-1 package is pre-installed, then a tampered package must fail with status 1 and must not trigger any load of the installed one.
cases.comparison: r3: 'claude update' runs 'pkg install' then 'pkg load claude' in that order and propagates the status. On a dynamic build the ok scenario requires status 0, the installed files exact, and one load after install. On a static build the ok scenario requires a non-zero status, the install present, no load, and the refusal 'this executable is static and cannot load shared objects'. Both print ok: contract=honoured only when that outcome holds. loadfail stays status 1 with the install present, and noinstall stays a refused install that loads nothing.
